findings.evidence: Cocycle.lean:62 states `D (g * h) = single (π g) (1 : ZMod p) • D h + D g`; Cocycle.lean:67-68 installs the compHom action; Cocycle.lean:75-77 obtains `hDcoc` from `freeProP.exists_mem_Z1_forall_apply_of_eq`, which is stated over `[DistribMulAction (freeProP p X) M]` (Free/Cocycle.lean:67, 91) with `mem_Z1_iff` giving `IsCocycle₁` in terms of that instance's `•`. Named lemmas: `MulAction.compHom_smul_def` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Action/Hom.lean:60), `MonoidAlgebra.of_apply` from `@[simps! apply] def of` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Defs.lean:660-661).
findings.fix: Make the bridge explicit: `have hsmul (g : freeProP p X) (m : X → MonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) G) : g • m = single (π g) (1 : ZMod p) • m := by funext i; rw [MulAction.compHom_smul_def, MonoidAlgebra.of_apply]` (adjusting for `Pi.smul_apply`), then `simpa only [hsmul] using hDcoc` and use it for the `ContinuousSMul` field too — or, failing that, add a comment stating that the local action is by definition multiplication by `single (π g) 1`.
findings.issue: `exact ⟨D, _, hDcoc, hDof⟩` bridges two different smul instance paths by bare defeq, with no comment: `hDcoc` comes from `Z1` over the locally installed `DistribMulAction.compHom _ ((MonoidAlgebra.of _ _).comp π.toMonoidHom)` (line 67), so its `g • D h` is `of (π g) * ·` pointwise, while the stated conclusion (line 62) uses the global `single (π g) 1 • ·`. The same unfolding is relied on in the `ContinuousSMul` field (lines 69-71), where `Continuous ((fun y ↦ single y.1 1 * y.2) ∘ Prod.map π id)` is handed to the goal `Continuous fun q ↦ q.1 • q.2`.

findings.evidence: `MonoidAlgebra.range_linearCombination_eq_ker_augmentation` concludes `LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination …) = RingHom.ker (augmentation R G)` (TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/RelationModule/Basic.lean:115-119); `Fintype.range_linearCombination : LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R v) = Submodule.span R (Set.range v)` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Finsupp/LinearCombination.lean:340-341).
findings.fix: Ascribe the type and rewrite explicitly: `have hspan : Submodule.span (MonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) G) (Set.range fun i ↦ single (π (freeProP.of i)) (1 : ZMod p) - 1) = RingHom.ker (MonoidAlgebra.augmentation (ZMod p) G) := by rw [← Fintype.range_linearCombination]; exact MonoidAlgebra.range_linearCombination_eq_ker_augmentation hgen`.
findings.issue: `have hspan := Fintype.range_linearCombination … ▸ MonoidAlgebra.range_linearCombination_eq_ker_augmentation hgen` has no ascribed type, so the statement actually used (and hence the `I` and `x` that the `_` placeholders on lines 125-126 resolve to) is invisible to a reader, and the rewrite direction is left to `▸`'s motive inference.

summary: Proofs are otherwise robust and well-commented, and the prior round's filtration/right-ideal reproof is fixed. Two issues remain: the cocycle construction silently identifies a locally installed `compHom` action with the statement's explicit `single (π g) 1 • ·` smul (twice), and a key hypothesis is produced by an unascribed term-mode `▸`.
